text:
maria: deploybot just paused the promo to staging — CI flagged a cache validation mismatch for artifact tortoise-v3.1.0 (sha mismatch vs registry). integration tests 12/24 failing. change window at 13:00 PT. do we pin to v3.0.9 or try reupload?

deploy-bot: [auto] promo stalled: checks failed -> cache-validation-error. see logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1755550000/cache-verify

jon: looking. I can reproduce the sha mismatch locally with curl + sha256sum. headers on the uploaded blob look weird (two different content-lengths).

lee: that smells like a multipart upload finalization race — sometimes the last part isn't flushed and the registry returns a different etag. saw this earlier with large wheels.

sam: if we need to unblock the release quickly, pinning to v3.0.9 (green last night) is the fastest. but that needs prod lead +1.

maria: agree pin is fastest. who can do manual pin + re-promote if reupload fails? or do we attempt reupload first?

jon: I'll try reupload to the mirror and retrigger CI. if reupload checksum matches we'll retry promo. if not, we should pin.

deploy-bot: Manual promo available: `/promote tortoise v3.0.9 --force` (requires approver role). Promo currently paused by CI.

lee: starting reupload now: ```bash
gsutil cp build/tortoise-v3.1.0.tar.gz gs://release-mirror/release-1755550000/tortoise-v3.1.0.tar.gz
sha256sum build/tortoise-v3.1.0.tar.gz
gsutil hash -m gs://release-mirror/release-1755550000/tortoise-v3.1.0.tar.gz
```

jon: reupload finished. mirror checksum matches local sha256. kicked the CI retry (rerun: integration-suite).

sam: fallback plan if CI still fails: manual pin to v3.0.9, update release notes with rollback rationale and open ticket to investigate multipart finalization. I'll pre-write the note.

maria: thanks. @lee keep an eye on the CI run. I'll draft the rollback blurb in the release notes so it's ready if we need it.

deploy-bot: CI retry complete: integration-suite passed 24/24. Promo unpaused but waiting on change window approval.

sam: :thumbsup: approving change window for 13:10 PT. maria please merge release-note update if we decide to pin later.

maria: will do — good job debugging quickly everyone.
